typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		EXPIRATION_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LOAD_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EXPIRATION_DATE as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LOAD_DATE = Load_Date,
		EXPIRATION_DATE,
		DESCRIPTION,
		BOOK_NAME,
		TRADE_ID,
		TRADE_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
